| description = Spawns at guard tower (#5) and proceeds to slowly patrol between {{loc|Qeynos Hills|(3, 1095), (1035, -810), (4566, -955), (4413, -547)|four points}}, sometimes pausing for about a minute. Each loop takes about 30 minutes unhindered.

{{loc|Qeynos Hills|(1035, -810)|Guard Tower}} > {{loc|Qeynos Hills|(3, 1095)|Southwest Wall}} > {{loc|Qeynos Hills|(4566, -955)|North Ruins}} > Southwest Wall > Guard Tower > {{loc|Qeynos Hills|(4413, -547)|North ridge}} > Guard Tower.

Interestingly, he will kill any gnolls in his path, but does not seems to care about the undead that he is tasked with investigating.

WILL ATTACK AND KILL PYZJN.  Ugh... >_<

Will Lay on Hands if within melee range; does not heal if kept at range.
